"Pet carriers at dawn stayed on our minds, and thank you for your full message". We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of a companion animal travel arrangement, and that the experience left you disappointed and concerned about the care and clarity you received.

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress this caused. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk expects every contact to be prompt, respectful, and clear, especially when a traveler is seeking reassurance about a pet's journey. When service falls short of that standard, we take the matter seriously and review it carefully.

Our desk has examined the details available to us and has shared the matter with the relevant team for follow-up. We are also reinforcing internal guidance so that future updates are given in a more consistent and considerate manner. Where a pet's travel plan needs attention, our aim is to provide practical direction without delay and to keep communication calm, concise, and helpful.

We appreciate the patience shown while this concern is being addressed. If any part of the travel experience remains unresolved, please reply with the points that need clarification, and we will ensure that the appropriate staff review them. We are committed to improving the way we support travelers and their companions, and we regret that our service did not reflect that commitment on this occasion.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for giving us the opportunity to respond. We value your trust and will continue working to make our companion animal support more reliable and respectful.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
